title: MSFS 2020 iniBuilds Airbus A321LR released! (pricing, liveries & free package explained)
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Today, we break down a major new airliner arrival on the MSFS 2020 Marketplace—bringing true transatlantic narrowbody capability to line pilots with the newly backported iniBuilds Airbus A321LR (Long Range).

To help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget, we inspect this new Marketplace release and explain why two separate listings appeared:

iniBuilds / Microsoft Airbus A321LR: The extended-range variant of Airbus’s flagship twin-jet airliner lands in MSFS 2020. Powered by twin CFM LEAP-1A engines delivering a 4,000 nautical mile range and a 455 KTAS cruise speed, this airframe brings transoceanic airline operations right to your simulator. We review the cockpit visuals, system fidelity, passenger configurations, discount conditions depending on your MSFS edition, and the 13 included liveries (including Jet2, Wizz Air, Spirit Airlines, easyJet, and Air New Zealand).

Airbus A321LR Enhanced Package (Free Download): If you spotted a second listing marked 100% free, there is an important catch. This package is an official performance optimization add-on designed to manage memory footprint, restrict VRAM usage, and streamline download sizing—crucial for stability and Xbox simmers. We break down the dependency requirements and why you must claim it right after securing the base airframe.

Whether you are planning your first six-hour transatlantic hop or organizing medium-haul scheduled routes, we evaluate this release to help you decide what truly deserves a spot in your simulator installation.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below! What will your first route be in the A321LR?
